feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Esther Rantzen's farewell message shared by her family
articles.summary: The family of Dame Esther Rantzen have revealed details of a farewell message written before she died, in which the 86-year-old said she felt "deprived of any choice over my own death".

articles.title: Apollo among suitors for €7bn spreads giant Flora
articles.summary: A pack of buyout firms will this week submit initial offers for Flora Food Group, the spreads giant behind brands including I Can't Believe It's Not Butter.

articles.title: Second man arrested on suspicion of murder after woman stabbed to death
articles.summary: A second man has been arrested on suspicion of murder after a woman was killed in a stabbing in Manchester.

articles.title: Actor and boxer among mourners of ex-gangster whose life was made into film
articles.summary: Family and friends paid their respects at the funeral of former Glasgow gangster Paul Ferris.

articles.title: Man admits Huntingdon train stabbings - but still faces trial on attempted murder charges
articles.summary: A man has admitted stabbing 10 people on a London-bound LNER train - but still faces trial on more serious attempted murder charges.

articles.title: Two men and two women arrested after police officer shot
articles.summary: Two men and two women have been arrested after a police officer was shot and injured in Nottingham city centre at the weekend.

articles.title: Police investigating threatening 'hoax' emails sent to schools
articles.summary: Police in Northern Ireland and Scotland are investigating after threatening emails, deemed to be a hoax, were sent to hundreds of schools.

articles.title: Two teenagers dead after car crash in Suffolk village
articles.summary: Two teenagers have died after a car crash in a Suffolk village, police have said.
